**This repository is archived and no longer accepts issues.**

These are solutions to the **1st edition** of *R for Data Science*. The
[2nd edition](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/) has its own
[solutions](https://mine-cetinkaya-rundel.github.io/r4ds-solutions/), which are
actively maintained.

Please report problems with the current solutions at
<https://github.com/mine-cetinkaya-rundel/r4ds-solutions/issues>.
